why: The heuristic's rung on content 9659f610, after the catalogue moved: nine new tier-2 spells, Meteor, Ice Spear and Tranquilizer Dart reworked, Soothing Chant, five tier-3 spells raised and the 8-to-14-round target (ADR 0086), Infectious Blast and the Revenant Guards' ward (#245 to #247). Every weights file was searched on older content. On the 200 benchmark seeds mirrored, search-19 still leads the heuristics at 0.846 mean against the other five, but kill-first is close at 0.728 and holds search-19 to 0.557 head to head; greedy is last at 0.060. lookahead-30 collapsed again (0.464 mean, 0.160 against search-19, 0.020 against kill-first), while the lookahead played with search-19's weights leads everything at 0.907 and beats search-19 0.705 (journal, 2026-09-30). So the rung starts from search-19 against greedy, kill-first, search-21, stun-first and pressure-floor, all under the start's floor, with the lookahead on search-19's weights seated on the first 50 seeds only, the way search 27 seated lookahead-20: it is the one opponent search-19 does not beat, and it costs several heuristics. 5 rounds of 8, seed 0, as search 27 ran; the engine is about 40 % faster since #242, which pays for the longer matches of this catalogue. What would make it a rung: a set that beats search-19 on seeds it never saw against kill-first and the lookahead without falling below it against the rest.
